hypothesis: On country-years where the rules found no event (no primary balance move of 1.5% of GDP or more and no large devaluation in that year or the year before), the placebo p-value of What happened after is at or below 0.10 in about 10% of cases: the method rarely finds an effect where, by the rules, nothing happened.
method: synth-v1 (src/utils/syntheticControl.ts): twin from the ten years before, penalty 0.1, placebo in space over every donor; pseudo-events drawn by src/utils/synthCheck.ts
knownLimits: Pseudo-events are years with no event found by the two data rules; other changes (laws, programmes, shocks) may still have happened in them, which would raise the false-alarm rate, not lower it.
Yearly figures only; the fit uses today's figures, not the figures as first published.
Power (a made-up jump of one standard deviation from the change year) is reported, not a pass condition: it depends on how noisy each country's figures are.
Draws whose result is Missing (too few years or donors, outside the range, loose fit) are counted and listed, not used; the test says nothing about cases the screen would not show.
